proof_body:
by
  intro a b c d
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, y, h, h1, h2⟩
    rcases h with hx | hy
    · have hm : (a * d - b * c) * x = 0 := by linear_combination d * h1 - b * h2
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hm).resolve_right hx
    · have hm : (a * d - b * c) * y = 0 := by linear_combination a * h2 - c * h1
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hm).resolve_right hy
  · intro hD
    by_cases hab : a ≠ 0 ∨ b ≠ 0
    · refine ⟨-b, a, ?_, by ring, by linarith⟩
      rcases hab with h | h
      · exact Or.inr h
      · exact Or.inl (neg_ne_zero.mpr h)
    · have ha : a = 0 := by
        by_contra h
        exact hab (Or.inl h)
      have hb : b = 0 := by
        by_contra h
        exact hab (Or.inr h)
      by_cases hcd : c ≠ 0 ∨ d ≠ 0
      · refine ⟨-d, c, ?_, by rw [ha, hb]; ring, by ring⟩
        rcases hcd with h | h
        · exact Or.inr h
        · exact Or.inl (neg_ne_zero.mpr h)
      · have hc : c = 0 := by
          by_contra h
          exact hcd (Or.inl h)
        have hd : d = 0 := by
          by_contra h
          exact hcd (Or.inr h)
        exact ⟨1, 0, Or.inl one_ne_zero, by rw [ha, hb]; ring, by rw [hc, hd]; ring⟩
